title: Inverted condition for adding OPTIONS
detail: The code adds the OPTIONS method when `provide_automatic_options` is False, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This causes routes that should automatically provide OPTIONS responses to miss the OPTIONS method, and routes that explicitly disable it to incorrectly receive an OPTIONS handler.
note: Says the condition is inverted: OPTIONS is added when the setting is off.

title: Inverted wait_ready logic
detail: The code returns from the request loop when wait_ready() returns True (data arrived), but the comment and intended behavior are to return only when the stream closes (wait_ready() returns False). This causes the server to exit the loop prematurely after the first request.

title: Incorrect disabled plugins check
detail: The condition checks if disabled_plugins is None and then attempts to split it, which will raise an AttributeError. The intended logic is to skip loading when disabled_plugins is not None and the entry point name is in the list.
note: Names the planted `is None` and the `None.split` it leads to.

title: Return of negative width value
detail: When the binary search finds a table entry with width == -1 (indicating a non-printable or zero-width character), the code now returns -1 directly instead of converting it to 0. This can cause callers to receive a negative width, leading to incorrect cell calculations or crashes when used in arithmetic.
